title: Happy Young Couple in Grassy Park, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of an affectionate young couple embracing on a grassy lawn during a sunny day. The young woman wears a casual short-sleeved top, a pleated skirt, ankle socks, and sandals, smiling warmly into the camera. The young man has dark wavy hair and wears a light-colored long-sleeve knit shirt with patch pockets, cuffed slacks, and two-tone shoes, wrapping his arm around her waist. In the distant background, rolling park grounds feature parked pre-war automobiles and other visitors enjoying leisure time.
